name: Customizable USB stick and SD card holder

captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a customizable storage holder for digital media, featuring distinct sections for different devices. One half of the holder contains thin, deep slots designed to hold standard SD cards vertically. The other half features wider, rectangular slots for USB flash drives, alongside an angled front face that contains a row of smaller slots suitable for Micro SD cards. The blocky body has rounded top edges, a chamfered front slope on the USB side, and interlocking tabs on one end with matching slot recesses on the opposite end for modular daisy-chaining.
captions.instruction: Create a highly customizable, modular storage holder in OpenSCAD for USB sticks, SD cards, and Micro SD cards. The design should allow the user to toggle between device types, adjust the number of slots and their spacing, choose the order of the SD and USB sections, and include interlocking connection tabs and slots on the sides for modular expansion.
captions.factory: The script defines a modular holder using the difference of roundedBox primitives (from MCAD/boxes.scad) and subtracted cubes for the device slots. The 'USB_MicroSD' module creates a rounded block, cuts a 45-degree chamfer along the front with a rotated cube, and generates USB slots and Micro SD slots using for-loops and translated cubes. The 'SD' module similarly creates a rounded box and subtracts vertical rectangular slots. These sections are combined using union, and modular interlocking connectors are appended or subtracted using extrusions of custom polygons defined in 'TAB' and 'SLOT' modules.
